releases.name: v0.12.0 — AI Studio 0.3.4-magpie.1, Gemini Web backend 4.28.0-magpie.1
releases.body:
## Backends

- **Managed AI Studio [0.3.4-magpie.1](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/releases/tag/studio-v0.3.4-magpie.1)**, based on upstream `v0.3.4` (`a4092efcdf358775339aa27cbb4db027fdf8f100`). Includes upstream `v0.3.3` and `v0.3.4`: `fill-first` account priority ordering (`ACCOUNT_ORDER`) with drag-and-drop sorting in the admin UI, per-model dedicated account pools (`MODEL_ACCOUNTS`), priority-aware warm worker selection, Google AI Ultra tier detection, SpiderMonkey worker shutdown crash fix on >1 s destroy timeout, immediate account enable/disable with background worker drain, automatic dismissal of Google AI welcome dialogs, 30 s WAA image hang protection, Responses stream keepalive, escalating cooldowns (1/5/15/30/60 min) for `-build` per-user quota, and the revamped admin UI. The plugin preserves `ACCOUNT_ORDER` and `MODEL_ACCOUNTS` across restarts, isolates them from host environment variables, orders the Magpie pool usage card and account selector by `ACCOUNT_ORDER`, and scopes model cooldowns to `MODEL_ACCOUNTS`. Both Magpie patches carry over unchanged, and Camoufox (`152.0.4-beta.29`) is unchanged so upgrading does not download it again. (#51, #52)
- **Gemini Web backend [4.28.0-magpie.1](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/releases/tag/backend-v4.28.0-magpie.1)**, based on upstream `v4.28.0` (`ed0f5ad8b16af4079fbcaf66255e6645c9893d1f`). Adds configurable timeout retries (`retry_on_timeout`, with silence-based `StallError` timeouts integrated), periodic SSE streaming keepalive comments (`stream_keepalive_sec`) to prevent intermediate proxy idle disconnects, and Gemini `/v1/models/{model}:action` endpoint compatibility alongside `/v1beta` for `google-genai` 3.x clients. The official rollback channel (`npm run backend:install:upstream`) now pins upstream `v4.28.0`. (#52)

## Upgrade

Install the attached `magpie-gemini-web-0.12.0.tgz` or update through npm. Stop any running managed `gemini-web2api-go` or `AIStudio2API` process (`npm run studio:stop` / `npm run backend:stop`); the next managed start upgrades the binary while keeping your accounts and settings. Users of the 0.11.0 plugin move from AI Studio 0.3.2-magpie.1 directly to 0.3.4-magpie.1 and from Gemini Web backend 4.27.1-magpie.1 to 4.28.0-magpie.1.

## Validation

- All 223 tests (221 passed, 2 skipped) at the release commit `eaf95d5990e7f9a0e688bf616225bd949cdd5d3e`.
- All five native AI Studio runners ([run 42751066416](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/actions/runs/42751066416)) and all six native Gemini Web backend runners ([run 42751037890](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/actions/runs/42751037890)) rebuilt from pinned sources, matched SHA-256 pins, and passed isolated installation smoke tests.

Full changelog: https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/compare/v0.11.0...v0.12.0

releases.name: AI Studio 0.3.4-magpie.1
releases.body:
AI Studio backend based on upstream v0.3.4 (`a4092efcdf358775339aa27cbb4db027fdf8f100`), managed exclusively by the Magpie plugin.

- **Upstream v0.3.4 (`a4092efcdf358775339aa27cbb4db027fdf8f100`):** fixes SpiderMonkey worker shutdown crash on >1 s destroy timeout; makes account enable/disable immediate with background worker drain and sync; auto-dismisses Google AI welcome dialogs (#125); caps WAA image request hangs at 30 s (#122); adds Responses stream keepalive; adds escalating cooldowns (1/5/15/30/60 min) for `-build` assistant per-user quota (#126); revamps the admin UI (including a dedicated Magpie access guide).
- **Upstream v0.3.3 (`718ea76f1c0d5a981c6368f936ec29c1acc5429e`):** adds `fill-first` account priority ordering (`ACCOUNT_ORDER`) with drag-and-drop sorting in the admin UI, per-model dedicated account pools (`MODEL_ACCOUNTS`), priority-aware warm worker selection, continuation history cleanup, and Google AI Ultra tier detection.
- **Managed configuration (`patches/studio-0.2.19-managed-config.patch`) and safe request-body migration (`patches/studio-0.2.17-preserve-request-bodies.patch`):** both apply unchanged to `v0.3.4`. `ACCOUNT_ORDER` and `MODEL_ACCOUNTS` saved in the admin page are preserved across restarts and isolated from host environment variables.

Source: upstream commit `a4092efcdf358775339aa27cbb4db027fdf8f100` plus the two patches recorded in `build.json`. Go 1.27.1, Camoufox 152.0.4-beta.29, SpiderMonkey v152.0.4-aistudio2api.1, libwebp v1.6.0-aistudio2api.1, Zig 0.16.0 (Linux), llvm-mingw 20261020 (Windows), Xcode 26.3 (macOS). Build instructions: `docs/studio-release.md`.

Validation: all five native runners in [the verification workflow](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/actions/runs/42751066416) passed at the release commit `eaf95d5990e7f9a0e688bf616225bd949cdd5d3e`.

releases.name: Optimized backend 4.28.0-magpie.1
releases.body:
Ready-to-run optimized backend for **macOS, Linux and Windows, on x64 and arm64**, built from upstream v4.28.0 with `patches/argon.patch`.

New in this backend (from upstream v4.28.0, merged into the Magpie patch):

- **Configurable timeout retries (`retry_on_timeout`, upstream #70).** Upstream adds `retry_on_timeout` (default `true`) so timeout failures can optionally stop without retrying; `StallError` implements `Timeout() bool` and `Temporary() bool` so silence-based timeouts participate cleanly in `retry_on_timeout`.
- **Streaming keepalive comments (`stream_keepalive_sec`, upstream #70).** Periodic `: keepalive` SSE comments can be emitted while waiting on upstream streaming responses to prevent intermediate proxy idle disconnects.
- **Gemini `/v1` endpoint compatibility.** `/v1/models/{model}:action` routes alongside `/v1beta/models/{model}:action`, preventing 404 errors with `google-genai` 3.x clients.
- Everything from 4.27.1-magpie.1 carries over: failure-reply retries, `tool_call` argument normalization, web UI markup rendering, `authuser` (`/u/N/`) support, XSRF caching, silence-based chat timing (180 s of silence by default), early tool-call completion, cancellation propagation, Argon model verification, and account proxy binding.

## Build provenance

- Upstream: [zexadev/gemini-web2api-go@ed0f5ad](https://github.com/zexadev/gemini-web2api-go/commit/ed0f5ad8b16af4079fbcaf66255e6645c9893d1f) (`v4.28.0`)
- Patch: `patches/argon.patch` (SHA-256 `5debc540d2d94c39877c9e973d681ef8bdb4330e15e4b8f39c4a3cd75f2f7289`, also recorded in `build.json`)
- Go: `1.27.1`, `CGO_ENABLED=0`, `-trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags="-s -w"`
- Reported backend version: `4.28.0-magpie.1`
- Included: six executables, patched source archive, `build.json`, `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and `LICENSE-UPSTREAM`.

## Validation

All seven jobs in [the release verification workflow](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/actions/runs/42751037890) passed at the release commit `eaf95d5990e7f9a0e688bf616225bd949cdd5d3e`.

releases.name: v0.11.0 — AI Studio 0.3.2-magpie.1, Gemini Web backend 4.27.1-magpie.1
releases.body:
## Backends

- **Managed AI Studio [0.3.2-magpie.1](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/releases/tag/studio-v0.3.2-magpie.1)**, based on upstream `v0.3.2` (`4c44cb9765aa9fd497b91db1f5c1573504b9b85f`). Includes upstream v0.3.1 and v0.3.2: content-policy finish reasons (SAFETY, RECITATION, …) are now returned as errors carrying the upstream reason instead of a silently truncated reply, Build model tool-call continuation, daily-limit cooldown fallback, Omni inline images/video, faster long-text and worker cold start, AVX2/NEON media encoding and libwebp 1.6.0. Both Magpie patches carry over unchanged; the new `HIDE_DOCK_ICON` setting is preserved from the admin page and isolated from the host environment. Camoufox is unchanged, so upgrading does not download it again. (#48, #49)
- **Gemini Web backend [4.27.1-magpie.1](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/releases/tag/backend-v4.27.1-magpie.1)**, based on upstream `v4.27.1`. Canned failure replies ("Sorry, something went wrong…") are detected before any text is streamed and retried; `tool_call` arguments are always a JSON object (no more `"arguments": "null"` / "must be a JSON object" errors in agent runs); web UI component tags (`<Sequence>`, `<Carousel>`, …) are rendered as Markdown; the dead `image_generation_content` placeholder link is removed from image replies. The official rollback channel (`npm run backend:install:upstream`) now pins upstream `v4.27.1`. (#50)

## Upgrade

Install the attached `magpie-gemini-web-0.11.0.tgz` or update through npm. Stop any running managed `gemini-web2api-go` or `AIStudio2API` process (`npm run studio:stop` / `npm run backend:stop`); the next managed start upgrades the binary while keeping your accounts and settings. Users of the 0.10.0 plugin move from AI Studio 0.3.0-magpie.1 directly to 0.3.2-magpie.1.

## Validation

- All 222 tests (220 passed, 2 skipped) at the release commit `ce41cb3a60c79b4da65aae008d0a9757dd8bc7e8`.
- All five native AI Studio runners ([run 42460565674](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/actions/runs/42460565674)) and all six native Gemini Web backend runners ([run 42460562002](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/actions/runs/42460562002)) rebuilt from pinned sources, matched SHA-256 pins, and passed isolated installation smoke tests.

Full changelog: https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/compare/v0.10.0...v0.11.0

releases.name: AI Studio 0.3.2-magpie.1
releases.body:
AI Studio backend based on upstream v0.3.2 (`4c44cb9765aa9fd497b91db1f5c1573504b9b85f`), managed exclusively by the Magpie plugin.

- **Upstream v0.3.2 (`4c44cb9765aa9fd497b91db1f5c1573504b9b85f`):** content-policy finish reasons (safety, recitation, blocklist, prohibited content, SPII and their image variants) are now reported as errors with the upstream reason; Build model tool-call continuation; daily-limit cooldown fallback; Omni inline images and video; attachment preview and video frame extraction settings; long-text, worker cold-start and Camoufox page performance fixes. Also includes everything from upstream v0.3.1 (AVX2/NEON image and audio encoding, libwebp 1.6.0 lossy WebP, crash and warm sign-in fixes, 10-second streaming heartbeats).
- **New `HIDE_DOCK_ICON` setting:** the value saved in the admin page is preserved and host environment variables of the same name are isolated from the managed service. It only affects the upstream desktop build; the managed build is still built without the `desktop` tag.
- **Managed configuration (`patches/studio-0.2.19-managed-config.patch`) and safe request-body migration (`patches/studio-0.2.17-preserve-request-bodies.patch`):** both apply unchanged to `v0.3.2`.

Source: upstream commit `4c44cb9765aa9fd497b91db1f5c1573504b9b85f` plus the two patches recorded in `build.json`. Go 1.27.1, Camoufox 152.0.4-beta.29, SpiderMonkey v152.0.4-aistudio2api.1, libwebp v1.6.0-aistudio2api.1, Zig 0.16.0 (Linux), llvm-mingw 20261020 (Windows), Xcode 26.3 (macOS). Build instructions: `docs/studio-release.md`.

Validation: all five native runners in [the verification workflow](https://github.com/BUKOWSKIREAL/magpie-gemini-web/actions/runs/42460565674) passed at the release commit `ce41cb3a60c79b4da65aae008d0a9757dd8bc7e8`.
